paragraphs.text: Grunn is a ape warrior from Yavimaya , Dominaria .

The apes of Yavimaya are sapient and engage in a form of ancestor worship that draws strength from the spirits of their forebears. Their most accomplished warrior is Grunn, a hermit and unrivaled king of his patch of Yavimaya. Not even other gorillas are welcome there, as Grunn believes his ancestors alone are worthy company.
